commit.message:
docs: correct README Key Capabilities accuracy and diagram granularity

- Removed a fabricated "reorder slides" claim -- SlideCollection/ISlideCollection
  has no reorder/move/swap method of any kind (verified by reading the full
  public surface: addClone/insertClone x3, addEmptySlide/insertEmptySlide,
  remove/removeAt, iteration only). Reorder exists only on ShapeCollection
  (shapes within a slide), which is already, correctly, documented elsewhere
  in this same file.
- Fixed "arrowhead alignment" -> "arrowhead style, width, and length". The
  original phrasing conflated two unrelated LineFormat properties: the real
  arrowhead properties are style/width/length; getAlignment()/setAlignment()
  controls the line's own pen alignment (OOXML algn attribute), unrelated to
  arrowheads.
- Added a real, previously undocumented capability: per-slide visibility
  control via ISlide.setHidden()/isHidden() during a slideshow.
- Corrected the At a Glance diagram, which had lost real granularity relative
  to this product's own Key Capabilities text and its sibling C++ README:
  Fill/Line/Effects/3D formatting (4 distinct, substantial capability areas)
  were crammed into one node; Connectors (a shape type, same method family as
  AutoShape/Table/PictureFrame) was incoherently paired with unrelated
  document-properties in another node; and a data-integrity guarantee
  (round-trip preservation of unknown XML) was promoted to a capability node
  it doesn't belong as. Restructured to 8 nodes matching the real capability
  boundaries already documented in Key Capabilities.

Verification: every class/method claim above was independently confirmed
against the real, current source (ISlideCollection.java, SlideCollection.java,
LineFormat.java, Slide.java, ISlide.java) before being added or changed. The
diagram restructure reuses only capability groupings already stated in this
file's own Key Capabilities section -- no new claims introduced.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
